# V1.10.3

Section: Source

**V1.10.3** of *[Stormworks: Build and Rescue](https://stormworks.fandom.com/wiki/Stormworks:_Build_and_Rescue)* was released on February 14th, 2024.

## V1.10.3

Feature - [#21954](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/21954) Map icon block

This new block allows the player to choose which vehicles in their vehicle-group should render on the map. If no map icon block is found the default behaviour will remain to be rendering all vehicles in the group.

- Fix - [#23281](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/23281) Fixed zero pressure transfer through doors when in complete vacuum
- Fix - [#23076](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/23076) Leak rate issues at equal pressures
- Fix - [#23076](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/23076) Fluid backflow issues with vehicle damage leaks
- Fix - [#21818](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/21818) Seawater turns to freshwater across doorways
- Fix - [#21326](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/21326) Mis-tagged arid mission zone (Boat spawned in road / lag)
- Fix - [#21772](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/21772) Liquid rocket logic node typo
- Fix - [#21940](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/21940) Missing stars in skybox
- Fix - [#22078](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/22078) Space seats description
- Fix - [#22234](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/22234) Day night length sliders when above default length
- Fix - [#22306](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/22306) Transport supplies missions typos
- Fix - [#22365](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/22365) Fixed CO2 poisoning not working
- Fix - [#22658](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/22658) Workshop author map icon info broken

- Fix - [#21638](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/21638) MacOS game icon
- Fix - [#24096](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/24096) MacOS missing clouds
- Fix - [#21637](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/21637) MacOS game close crash
- Fix - [#21636](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/21636) MacOS quit multiplayer crash

- Fix - Leak at map border crash
- Fix - Animation blend crash
- Fix - Slider gripper brake crash
- Fix - [#23012](https://geometa.co.uk/support/stormworks/23012) Addon lua ropes resources crash
- Fix - Remove connectors crash
